Beginning cort explorations

Data prep:

g <- g %>% mutate(cort_s1 = cort_s1/1000,
                  cort_s2 = cort_s2/1000,
                  cort_s1_mother = cort_s1_mother/1000,
                  cort_s2_mother = cort_s2_mother/1000,
                  condition = weight/tarsus)
c <- read_rds("../data/cort_with_id.rds")  %>%
  mutate(condition = weight/tarsus,
         s1 = s1/1000,
         s2 = s2/1000,
         cort_s1_mother = cort_s1_mother/1000,
         cort_s2_mother = cort_s2_mother/1000)
